subject: GCP marketplace listing — procurement & co-sell workflow sync
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecloud.com>, Acme Cloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>
Cc: CloudLens Sales <sales@cloudlens.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP marketplace listing — procurement & co-sell workflow sync

Hi Lina / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for taking a first look at the listing intake we shared last week. We want to sync on the procurement and co-sell mechanics so the listing goes live with correct billing entitlements and co-sell registration enabled. High-level asks for today: 

- Confirm your preferred procurement flow for Marketplace purchases (GCP-billed via marketplace vs. PO + invoice).
- Confirm any mandatory contract terms or SOW flow we should route through DocuSign.
- Identify the procurement contact who will submit the PO and the expected approval lead time (we’re assuming 10–15 business days but want to be accurate).

I’ve attached a short product brief and a SKU mapping spreadsheet that maps our Redwood SKUs to GCP Marketplace SKUs. We’re also proposing a two-tier co-sell: (1) co-sell eligible for self-serve via catalog; (2) partner-assisted for larger entitlements with a manual PO path.

If useful, we can run a short 30-min checklist call this afternoon to lock down the procurement handoff and DocuSign timeline. Suggested attendees: Lina, your procurement lead, my ops lead (Karthik), and product ops (Marissa).

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-product-brief.pdf (3 pages), sku-mapping-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>, CloudLens Sales <sales@cloudlens.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace listing — procurement & co-sell workflow sync

Hi Jonas — thanks for the note and the materials. A couple quick clarifying questions before the call: 

1) For marketplace-billed purchases, are the SKUs set up to support monthly and annual billing cadence? Our finance team prefers annual commitments but we sometimes need monthly options for pilots.
2) For the partner-assisted PO path, does Redwood require a signed MSA up front or can we use a marketplace terms + SOW approach?

Procurement team (procure@acmecloud.com) is looped in. Please add a HubSpot/Deal link if you’d like our procurement system to automatically pick up the expected spend and line items.

I can join a 30-minute sync at 1:30pm PST if that works — otherwise send a proposed agenda and we’ll confirm.

Best,

Lina Park
Head of Strategic Procurement, AcmeCloud
lina.park@acmecloud.com

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, CloudLens Sales <sales@cloudlens.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace listing — procurement & co-sell workflow sync

Thanks Lina — 1:30pm PST works for me. Agenda below and a few clarifications in advance so the meeting is efficient: 

Proposed 30-min agenda (1:30–2:00pm PST):
- 5m: Introductions & program goals (enable co-sell + marketplace billing)
- 10m: Procurement options & billing cadence (marketplace billing vs PO/invoice)
- 8m: Contract flow & DocuSign timing for partner-assisted purchases
- 5m: Next steps & owners (PO submission date, HubSpot update, co-sell registration)

Quick answers to your questions: 
- Our SKU matrix supports both monthly and annual billing cadence. The SKU mapping sheet indicates which SKUs are available for prepaid annual commitment vs pay-as-you-go. (See sku-mapping-v1.xlsx)
- For partner-assisted enterprise deals we typically require a short MSA + SOW for legal clarity; however, we can support a marketplace-terms-first approach for pilots and low-value entitlements. If procurement needs an MSA, we’ll route via DocuSign; I’ve included the proposed MSA template as part of the procurement-checklist.docx attachment.

Prep items: 
- Procurement: confirm preferred cadence (monthly or annual) and the name/email of the person who will submit the PO.
- Legal: any redlines to the attached MSA template that need to be flagged before DocuSign.
- Sales Ops: update HubSpot deal (link below) with the expected SKU list so procurement can reference line items in the PO.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2025-GCP-023
GDrive SKU mapping: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SkuMapExample

See you at 1:30.

-Jonas

Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
Attachments: procurement-checklist.docx (procurement flow + MSA template)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: GCP marketplace listing — procurement & co-sell workflow sync

Adding a quick ops checklist we’ll follow on the call and afterward — want to make sure procurement has a clear handoff: 

1) SKU reconciliation: confirm the SKU line items in the attached spreadsheet (owner: Sales Ops)
2) Billing cadence decision: marketplace-billed (auto) vs PO/invoice (manual). If PO/invoice, procurement to confirm payment terms (Net30/Net45).
3) Co-sell registration: Lina to confirm if AcmeCloud will file a co-sell referral via the GCP Partner portal or if Redwood should start the registration. (owner: Sales)
4) DocuSign & legal: attach MSA + SOW if required. If MSA needed, expect 2–3 business days for initial review. (owner: Legal)
5) HubSpot update: Sales to add final SKU lines + expected ARR. (owner: Jonas)

Notes on edge cases we’ve seen: marketplace SKUs sometimes cannot represent complex multi-feature bundles. If Acme needs combined SKUs for procurement ease, we can create a single procurement SKU that invoices as a bundle but maps to multiple product SKUs internally. That usually requires a 48-hour ops lead time before listing is published.

I’ll be on the 1:30 call — I’ll bring the procurement checklist doc and a sample PO template.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

From: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace listing — procurement & co-sell workflow sync

Thanks everyone — good call. Quick summary and confirmed next steps from Acme: 

- Billing cadence: Acme prefers annual commitments for production deployments; pilots will be processed monthly via marketplace billing.
- Contract flow: For deals > $75k we’ll require a brief MSA + SOW signed via DocuSign. For deals <= $75k, marketplace terms are acceptable.
- Procurement contact: Procurement team will submit the PO. Point person is Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@acmecloud.com>. Expect PO within 10 business days once the SKU lines are final.
- Co-sell registration: Acme will start the co-sell referral in GCP Partner Portal; Redwood to provide the partner ID and listing URL (Jonas to send).

Action items: 
1) Jonas: send partner ID + listing URL + final SKU line export to Miguel and HubSpot (by EOD).
2) Karthik: prepare bundled procurement SKU option if requested (provide ETA).
3) Marissa / Stephanie: prepare MSA redline schedule if Acme requests changes (ready in 2 business days).

DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345-example
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2025-GCP-023

Looking forward to the listing going live — Miguel will be in touch after he receives the final SKU export.

Best,

Lina Park
Head of Strategic Procurement, AcmeCloud
